tagline: Live issue triage for your Discourse community, via the API
no_issues_body: Run a scan to pull topics from Discourse and generate a ranked issue list.
settings_body: Paste your own Anthropic API key and pick which Claude model runs the analysis. Stored only in this browser, sent directly to your backend.
key_required_body: Add your Anthropic API key in AI settings before running a scan.
ollama_hint: Point this at your local Ollama install — no API key needed.
custom_model_placeholder: Or type a custom model name you've pulled locally
forum_settings_body: Set which Discourse community to query, your API credentials, and how many pages to pull per scan. Everything here goes through Discourse's official REST API — no scraping involved. Leave blank to use the backend's defaults from .env.
discourse_api_key_placeholder: Leave blank to use the backend's server-side key
discourse_api_key_hint: Generate one at {{base_url}}/admin/api/keys, scoped to topics#latest, topics#show, categories#index.
discourse_api_key_configured: A server-side key is already configured — you can leave this blank.
max_pages_hint: Higher values cover more of the forum's history but take longer and use more API calls per scan.
